title: Resource efficiency: allocation gaps
description: Containers with no request or limit, with suggested values from observed usage.

panels.title: Containers with no CPU request
panels.description: Containers that run without this setting. Suggested = observed usage over the History window plus headroom.

targets.expr: (quantile_over_time(0.95, (max by (namespace, workload, container) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$ns"}[5m]), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "workload", "$1", "pod", "^(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}|-[a-z0-9]{5}|-[0-9]+)$")))[$window:5m])) unless on(namespace, workload, container) (max by (namespace, workload, container) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(k8s_container_cpu_request{k8s_namespace_name=~"$ns"}, "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.+)"), "pod", "$1", "k8s_pod_name", "(.+)"), "container", "$1", "k8s_container_name", "(.+)"), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+)"), "workload", "$1", "pod", "^(.+?)(-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}|-[a-z0-9]{5}|-[0-9]+)$")))

options.content: Not every gap is fixed in an app manifest. **Calico** workloads (calico-node, typha, kube-controllers, whisker, goldmane) are managed by the tigera-operator: set resources on the `Installation` / component resources. **Envoy gateway proxies** take them from the `EnvoyProxy` resource. **Control-plane static pods** (kube-apiserver, scheduler, controller-manager) come from the Talos machine config. Suggestions need several days of history to be meaningful; a CPU limit is deliberately not suggested.
